system.effect:
Target: Your Fairy-Type Pokémon
Effect: You spend 1 AP, creating 3 Fairy Lights that hover around the target. Whenever the target is attacked by a foe within 6 meters, it may expend a Fairy Light as a Free Action to either immediately gain a Tick of Temporary Hit Points, or to use the Move Fairy Wind as if it were on their Move List. Additionally, when using Fairy Lights, you may spend an additional AP to create an additional Fairy Light (when you have your Type-Linked Skill at Master, you can spend up to 2 additional AP, creating at most 5 Fairy Lights with a single use of Fairy Lights).

Fairy Lights provide mild lighting, comparable to a candle (a Burst 1 of light around a Fairy Light). As a Standard Action, your Pokémon can control the lights individually, but they must stay within 6 meters of the Pokémon that they were originally created for. Creatures within the Burst of a Fairy Light are treated as being illuminated and in visible range in darkness, and the New Moon and Fog Weather Conditions.
